title: Camp Grace

services.name: Fishing Tournament
services.desc: The Family Fishing Tournament at Camp Grace is a day of friendly competition, outdoor fun, and family connection, all set beside the beautiful Lake Blue on our campus. This annual event invites families and individuals of all ages to enjoy a day of fishing, fellowship, and a little friendly rivalry! Participants can cast their lines and compete for prizes in several categories, including biggest catch and most fish caught. Whether you’re an experienced angler or trying fishing for the first time, it’s the perfect opportunity to relax and enjoy God’s creation together. Cost is $10 per person or $40 for the family. services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: Family Camp Day at Camp Grace is a special opportunity for families to experience the excitement of camp together! Hosted each May at our campus in Fairmont, North Carolina, this free event is open to everyone and offers a fun, hands-on introduction to what Camp Grace is all about. Throughout the day, families can tour the campgrounds, meet our staff, and take part in sample camp activities that give a taste of the summer camp experience. From outdoor games and crafts to exploring the cabins and dining hall, Family Camp Day is designed to help families feel at home and confident about sending their children to camp.
